text: Almion is a deceased Altmer whose body can be found in Dawnbreak.
Alexadrin Fadras is a Dunmer residing in the city of Mournhold.
Am-Eepa is an Argonian blacksmith residing in Artisans Craftworks in Mournhold.
Almathea, also known as Priestess Almathea, is a character in . She can be found in the temple in Azra's Crossing with Acolyte Menlin.
Aloin Canne is a Breton found in the outlaws refuge beneath the city of Sentinel.
Alonas Drelen is a Dunmer residing in the city of Ebonheart.
Alexandra Conele is a Breton leader in the Daggerfall Covenant trying to take control of a powerful relic in the Vivec's Antlers.
Alfa is a Nord working as a maid in the Fighters Guild hall in Riften.
Alfarmuth is a Nord member of the Mages Guild found on Eyevea. He can be found with two other Nord members of the Guild, not far from the Eyevea Wayshrine.
Alforunn Wealdwalker is an ill Nord pilgrim resting at the Pilgrim's Rest Inn in Ivarstead. He is related to Odvild Wealdwalker.
Algunda Jagged-Peak is a Nord carpenter. She sells her wares at her stall, Jagged-Peak Carpentry & Supply, at the Riverside Markets in Stormhold.
Alison Jurard is a Breton enchanter and owner of the shop Stoneglow Enchantments in Shornhelm.
Alivusa is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She resides in their village in the Vale of the Ghost Snake.
Alkar is a Redguard member of the Mages Guild found on Eyevea.
Allan Edrald is a Breton in . He and his wife Krisandra Edrald are the proprietors of the Edrald Estate, where they live with their daughter Arlie Edrald.

Allene Pellingare is a Breton and one of the co-leaders, along with her brother Varaine, of the bandit gang occupying the Wayrest Sewers. She is also the daughter of Master Pellingare, a wealthy noble living in the city. She is fought as the final boss of Wayrest Sewers I. Garron resurrects her and her brother in Wayrest Sewers II, where they are fought as the final boss battle in the dungeon.
Alli Dren is a Dunmer patron of the Brooding Elf Inn in Quarantine Serk.
Allring is a Nord merchant found in Riften. He owns The Ringing Anvil alongside Hadriss at the Artisan's Hall.
Alma Desticus is an Imperial found in the ruins of Nagastani.
Alma Falas is an aspiring Dunmer mage attempting to get an invitation to the school of magic Shad Astula. She is first encountered in Mournhold but may later be found in Shad Astula.
Almur is a Redguard found in Sentinel and in the Rain Catcher Fields. He is the brother of Overseer Jahi.
Alphrennor is a Bosmer merchant of the outlaws found underneath Daggerfall.
Alskar is a Nord chef who works and sells his wares at J'darzi's stall, J'darzi Fine Imports, in Riften.
Alurami Redoran is a Dunmer of House Redoran found in Mournhold. She is found listening to Counts-the-Clouds's preaching outside the Tribunal Temple.
Aluri is a traveling Dunmer merchant found near Honrich Tower.
Alvaren Garoutte is a priest of Arkay leading a team of knights in search of powerful relics throughout Rivenspire.
Alvila is a Dunmer magus and a member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Nimalten.
Alvos Orain is a Dunmer soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at their camp near Fort Virak.

Am-Sakka is an Argonian provisioner found eating bread in the Foundation's Embrace marketplace in Vivec City. Before Update 14, he lived in the city of Stormhold. This character has no unique dialogue.
Alida is a Redguard traveler who was attacked by the Seventh Legion found at the Old Tower.
Alirfire is an Altmer beggar found in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Alrdorion is an Altmer soldier. He can be found in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Altholmir is a Bosmer smith and member of the Falinesti Faithful found at the Falinesti Autumn Site.
Alix Edette is a Breton noble residing in Wayrest. She is one of the targets listed in the Litany of Blood. She can be found in the docks.
Allunen Stoneshaper is a Reachman and the leader of the Stonetalon Clan members found within the Secluded Sewers in .
Alma Lollia is a Breton patron of the Stone Oasis Inn in Bergama.
Alverine Astier is a Breton outlaw residing in Belkarth. She has no unique dialogue.

Alvur Baren is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild as well as the Order of the Eye. He is found at the branches in either Elden Root, Mournhold or Wayrest. He seeks help in retrieving various artifacts tied to Sheogorath that were dispersed all across Tamriel when the Planemeld occurred.
Alessian Wraith is a wraith that appears in , on the Glenumbra Moors battlefield.
Alyze Metayer is a Breton battleground merchant working at Battle-Ready Market within the Gladiator's Quarters of Vivec City.
Alves Droth is a Dunmer residing in the Saint Delyn Plaza on the upper level of the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City.
Altansawen is an Altmer bard performing in the Saint Olms Waistworks in the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.

Alessio Guillon is a Breton member of the Spirit Wardens. He can be found at any inn in Tamriel, asking the Vestige to seek Rhea Opacarius at the Cloudy Dregs Inn, giving them the quest "The Missing Prophecy."
Alienist Llandras is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles who can be found at the Asylum Sanctorium in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City

Alveno Apo is a Dunmer soldier and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City. She can be found standing guard inside the Clockwork Basilica. they have no unique dialogue.
Alexis Ervine is a Breton who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset. He cannot be interacted with.
Aliskeeh is an argonian craftsman of the Bright-Throat Tribe sitting by the road, north of Bright-Throat Wayshrine.
Amahnin is a Redguard member of The Crowns who can be found inside A'tor's Oasis in the city of Bergama, Alik'r Desert.
Alldimar the Ghostmaker was a High King of Skyrim, who ruled the nation forty years after the death of the previous king.
Anarenen is an Altmer Alchemist who spends most of his time on the lowest level of the Ald'ruhn Mages Guild. Anarenen is an Associate Alchemist for the Mages Guild.

Amusei is an Argonian first seen in the Imperial City Waterfront taking the Thieves Guild admission test along with the Hero of Kvatch and Methredhel. Amusei has yet to make a living as a thief, and can be found living homeless when first encountered.
Amantius Allectus is an Imperial commoner who resides in his house in the Temple District of the Imperial City.
Amminus Gregori is an Imperial Knight and a member of the Cheydinhal City Guard.

The Ancestor Moth is a rare indigenous gypsy moth that is found throughout Ancestor Glades of Tamriel, but can mostly be found deep within the Jerall Mountains of Cyrodiil where they are worshipped and cared for by the Cult of the Ancestor Moth. Ancestor Moths are mystical creatures and are connected with Ancient Magic that gives people the ability to read Elder Scrolls.
Anas Ulven is a Dunmer Thief who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. He is a member of the Camonna Tong. He sells thief tools and offers training.
An-Deesei is an Argonian who lives in Ebonheart, Morrowind. She can be found in the Argonian Mission. An-Deesei is also an member of Twin Lamps, an abolitionist fighting to end slavery.

Ambroise Canne is a Breton warrior and employee of the Surilie Brothers in Skingrad. Besides working in the vineyards, he also gains an income as a trainer in Blocking techniques. He believes his skills in handling a shield to not only be better than Fadus Calidius, the trainer in the Skingrad Fighters Guild, but also claims that Fadus would admit to Ambroise's superiority. He is willing to train most times during the day, but will not stop to teach anybody while he is eating or at the Great Chapel of Julianos. He learned most of what he knows about blocking from Andragil, a master trainer in Blocking, and will recommend her for advanced training.

Amiable Fanriene is a Breton conjurer who is quite paranoid about collapsing walls anywhere he is. He is almost always crouching down shielding his head. Amiable can be found near the inn The Choosy Beggar during most of the day.
Amkaos is one of the Dremora warriors located in Mankar Camoran's "paradise." He works under Orthe, and will thus be hostile towards the Hero once met.
Ancano is an Altmer mage at the College of Winterhold. He is a Thalmor operative, serving as an advisor to Arch-Mage Savos Aren and is the primary antagonist of the College of Winterhold questline.
Amaund Motierre is a Breton appearing in . He plays a role in the final quests of the Dark Brotherhood questline, seeking the assassination of the current Emperor, Titus Mede II.
Ambarys Rendar is a Dunmer in who owns the New Gnisis Cornerclub in the Gray Quarter of Windhelm. He sells food and drinks.

Amiel Septim was a son of Emperor Uriel Septim II, and brother to Pelagius Septim II. He was also the uncle of Antiochus, Potema, Cephorus, and Magnus Septim. In 3E 80, he was meeting with Arch-Mage of Mages Guild in Firsthold, so it is possible that he was a sorcerer. No other records of him or his deeds are found.

Queen Amodetha was the first wife of King Mantiarco, and was Queen of Solitude in the early Third Era. That said, there is very little known about her. She was beloved by her people, unlike her successor, Queen Potema.
Anasour Selitbael is a Dunmer archer who resides in the Ashlands of Vvardenfell. His camp is near the coordinates [5,13].

Anaxes is a Xivilai found in Mankar Camoran's Paradise. He is the lord of the Savage Garden and torments the Ascended Immortals. They trapped him so that he could do them no more harm. His master, Kathutet, sees this as a fitting punishment for allowing himself to be captured, but also sees this as an insult to him and their lord Mankar Camoran. He asks the Hero to free Anaxes.
Amring is a Bosmer acrobat. He met his demise in Shishi, being killed by members of House Redoran in response to House Telvanni setting up an outpost in the area.
Anaelle Bertault is a Breton scholar who may be found wandering the Alik'r Desert in Hammerfell. Anaelle is accompanying a wandering Redguard tribe in the Alik'r Desert.
An-Meeus is an Argonian residing in the region of Bal Foyen in Morrowind.

Anchor Guardian is a harvester formerly found The Wailing Prison during the opening quest, "Soul Shriven in Coldharbour." It was summoned by the projection of Molag Bal. The anchor guardian served as the boss of the quest, and was not a very difficult enemy to defeat.
Anabelle Manis is a Breton woodworker residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. She has a stall at the Lionguard Camp Market where she sells woodworking-related items.
Amuur is an Altmer living in the village of Phaer on the isle of Auridon.
Amelie Malanie is a Breton held hostage by the Red Rook Bandits in a her estate outside Daggerfall. After the Vestige rescues her, she says that they are her new hero.
Anala is a Khajiit who resides in the city of Vulkhel Guard in Auridon. She is a member of Captain Erronfaire's crew, and is involved in the quest "Unaccounted Crew."

Anaril is an Altmer residing in Mathiisen, Auridon. She can be found hanging around the bridge to enter the town. She is an Altmer supremacist who looks down on "lesser races," particularly on Khajiit who are working as cheap labor.
Anatole Thenitte is a Breton who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He can be found sitting down near Daggerfall Millworks.
Anais Vanne is a Breton residing on Vanne Farm, in the region of Stormhaven. She and her husband, Giraud, have barricaded themselves upstairs in one of the buildings on the farm.
Amal is a Breton residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is one of the three vendors in the Lion's Crown Outfitters.
Ami-El was the third Emperor of the Alessian Empire of Cyrodiil. Ami-El was the successor of Belharza, the Man-Bull, and was a noteworthy ally to the war-torn Skyrim.
Ambaril is an Altmer residing in Marbruk in the region of Greenshade.
Analande is an Altmer Star-Gazers residing in Belkarth in the region of Craglorn. She can be found in the Star-Gazers' Observatory in Ondil.
Anarume is an Altmer found at the Heritance Proving Ground, Auridon. Unlike many other Group Bosses, Anarume can be battled without the help of a group.
Ancalin is an Altmer residing in Skywatch in the region of Auridon.
Ancarive is an Altmer innkeeper residing in Marbruk in the region of Greenshade. He owns The Parchment & Horn in Marbruk.
Ambre Leraud is a Breton carpenter in Skywatch working at her shop, Island Woodworks.
Amandtea is a Nord residing in Mournhold. She can be found near the Mastercraft Exchange. She cannot be interacted with.
Amihild Last-Child is a Nord student residing in the Guild Plaza in Mournhold.
Amila Renim is a Dunmer leatherworker. She sells her wares at her stall, Renim's Luxurious Leathers, in the Royal Bazaar in Mournhold.
Amwyn is a Nord clothier residing in the city of Ebonheart, Stonefalls. She can be found at her shop at the Ebonheart Unified Metalworks, selling her wares.
Amil the Deft is a Dunmer prostitute working at The Ebony Flask in Ebonheart.
Ancestral Icemaster is a hostile spirit who can be found in Tanzelwil.
Ambarys Teran is a Dunmer guild trader. He sells his wares at his kiosk, Crystal Corner, in Vinedusk Village.
Ambre Gnarltree is a powerful member of the Reachmen who has taken over control of Shor's Stone Mine.
Amifar Windtorn is a Nord residing inside her family house in Riften.
Amitra is a Nord mage found near the Ragged Hills Wayshrine. With the help of her brother Harnald, she is investigating the presence of the Worm Cult in the Ragged Hills.
Amu is a Khajiit found at the Riverside Traders in Arenthia.
Amussa is an Argonian banker residing in the town of Davon's Watch, Stonefalls. She works at the Uveran Bank.
An-Jeen is an Argonian brewer residing in the city of Dhalmora, Bal Foyen.
An-Jeen-Sakka is an Argonian residing in Haj Uxith and later in the Hollow City, Coldharbour, in .
Anabelle Etanne is a Breton patron of the Cloudy Dregs Inn in Wayrest.
Anabelle Jegnole is a Breton patron of the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Anabeth Justal is a Breton patron of the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Anaka the Ink-Blooded is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is found in either the Marbruk guildhall, the Sentinel guildhall or the Windhelm guildhall.

Anal'a Tu'wha is a Redguard member of the warrior group called the Anka-Ra, who are currently participating in the fighting tournament in the Dragonstar Arena. He is the boss of the 5th round, The Celestial Ring.
Ambassador Raen is a Bosmer ambassador to the Drublog Clan found in Jathsogur. He also acts as the councilor of war of The Silvenar.
Ambassador Sariel is a Bosmer ambassador to the Drublog Clan found in Jathsogur. She also acts as the councilor of magic of The Silvenar.
Ancalmo is a dead Altmer member of the Mages Guild found in the Shademist Moors.
Aminyon is an Altmer banker of the Dominion found at their base inside the Imperial City Sewers.
Ambassador Lazgara is an Orsimer found in Daggerfall, Davon's Watch, and Vulkhel Guard. She serves Forge-Mother Alga of Orsinium, who is recruiting outsiders to aid in its rebuilding.
Anbi is a Khajiit fence and member of the Thieves Guild. She operates in the Thieves Den of Abah's Landing.
Amanda Bruttia is an Imperial chef. She is working at Enrick's Public House in Anvil.

Amelie Crowe is a Breton assassin of the Dark Brotherhood initially found in the Anvil Outlaws Refuge in Anvil, The Gold Coast, or any outlaws refuge on Tamriel. She laters succeeds in joining the Dark Brotherhood after Filling the Void is completed, and without an eyepatch.
Ancalin the Smith is an Altmer residing in Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
An-Jeen-Seek is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild. He takes part in the final assault on Molag Bal at The Endless Stair.
Anais Velmont is a Breton member of the Velmont Family. She is also a childhood friend of Walks-Softly.
An-Taeed is an Argonian slave found at the Council House in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell.
Amili Yahaz is a Dunmer caravaner residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. She is the owner of the silt strider Risa.
Ambucilion is an Altmer residing within Thalmor Headquarters in Woodhearth, Greenshade.
Amronal Wispmother is a Wispmother that appears in . She can be located near Rootwatch Tower.
Amili Lloryn is a Dunmer member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in the Mnemonic Planisphere, Clockwork City.
Ambanmil is a unique vvardvark that appears in the Saint Delyn Waistworks within the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City, Vvardenfell, in . It sits next to its owner Milvela Uvayn.

Ancelhros is an Altmer pack merchant working at the branch of The Ruins Bazaar near the Dockworks in the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He notes that something "fishy" is happening at the Monastery of Serene Harmony in the city.
Amaleera is an Altmer who can be found in Ceporah Tower in Artaeum. Amaleera is a member of the Psijic Order
Amminus Entius is an Imperial quartermaster of the Order of the Hour. As of the events of , Amminus Entius is deceased.

Anais Davaux is a Breton courier, hired by Abnur Tharn to deliver the Vestige a message from him. She can be encountered in any of the three major Alliance cities, Daggerfall, Vulkhel Guard or Davon's Watch, as well as Rimmen.
Amel-Kiurz is an Argonian commoner of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Amalien is an Altmer residing in the the Antiquarian Circle in Solitude.
Amilya is an Altmer assassin residing in Lilmoth. She has no unique dialogue.

Analyst Othralas is a Dunmer researcher of the Mages Guild found in the Daedric Ruins of Ramimilk, Vvardenfell, in . She is examining the bones near the lava pool. She has no unique dialogue and cannot be interacted with.
Anes Hlaren is a Dunmer Nightblade and a Slave hunter residing in the village of Ald Velothi. He spends most of his time outdoors basking in the glow of the sun.
Andreas Draconis is an Imperial publican and a member of the Draconis family. Andreas runs The Drunken Dragon Inn and charges 20 a night.
Andorak Septim was a male Imperial born during the Third Era, and son of Uriel Septim IV.
Andilu Drothan is a Dunmer Alchemist who can be found in the Foreign Quarter of Vivec. She is a member of House Hlaalu, and is also an Alchemist.

Andre Maul is a Breton savant who resides in a Dwemer tower slightly north of Dagon Fel which he now calls home. Andre can mark the location of various landmarks on the Nerevarine's map and is a good source of information, but he is not involved in any quests and does not offer any services.

Anja Swift-Sailer is a Nord Commoner living in her shack on the docks of Dagon Fel. She wears common clothing and carries a key which does not open anything. Anja is never at home and is usually found wandering the street in front of Fjorrod's House.
Andilo Thelas is a Dunmer savant who lives in Gnaar Mok, Morrowind. She is a member of House Hlaalu. She can be found upstairs and outside on the balcony of Arenim Manor.

Angoril is an Altmer master-at-arms and a Knight Protector with the Imperial Legion. He is the highest-ranking member at Fort Pelagiad, and can be found on the upper floor where he trains fellow Legion members in melee skills. Angoril has a key to the fort's prison, which can be used to free New-Shoes Bragor. He does not have any quests to offer the Nerevarine, stating that it is quiet in Pelagiad but other Legion forts may be in need of help.
Count Andel Indarys is the Dunmer Count of Cheydinhal and father to Farwil Indarys. His wife, Llathasa Indarys died recently due to an apparent fall down the stairs.

Angalmo is an Altmer and a member of the Chorrol Mages Guild. He is an Apprentice Mysticism trainer and sells potions, alchemical ingredients and equipment, and Soul Gems to members and non-members alike. He has 800 and a Mercantile skill of 40, and is a very humble person.

Andragil is a Master Block trainer who lives on the second floor of a shack near the main entrance to Bravil, across from the Fighters Guild. She will agree to train the Hero after passing a blocking test. She is also growing a Nirnroot in a pot next to her bed.

Anguilon is a Bosmer pirate who currently resides at The Fo'c's'le in Anvil while The Serpent's Wake is being repaired. He seems to dislike strangers. He is not involved in any quests and does not offer any goods or services.
Angalsama is an Altmer Mage, and a devout follower of the Daedric Prince Sheogorath.
Anise is an elderly Nord who lives just southwest of Riverwood, where she can often be found gardening or sitting on a chair outside her cabin.
Angrenor Once-Honored is a Nord beggar and former Stormcloak Soldier in who lives on the streets of Windhelm. He can be found walking through the Gray Quarter or around Candlehearth Hall.
Andurs is a Nord priest of Arkay serving in the Hall of the Dead in Whiterun.
Angi is a Nord in who lives in seclusion in her camp south of Falkreath. Angi says she used to live in Helgen.
Annekke Crag-Jumper is a Nord archer in who lives in Darkwater Crossing with her husband, Verner Rock-Chucker.
Angeline Morrard is an elderly Breton in who is the owner of Angeline's Aromatics, in Solitude, which her niece, Vivienne Onis, helps her run.
Angvid is a Nord miner in who is found working in Whistling Mine southeast of Winterhold.
Andalin Hardil is a Dunmer warrior and a member of the Tribunal Temple who resides in the Ministry of Truth. She will treat any intruders she sees as a threat and attack on sight.
Andril Othran is a Dunmer Thief, and a member of the bandit gang that has occupied the stronghold of Andasreth. He is located on the lower level, and is hostile towards the Nerevarine.
Anel Rethelas is a hostile Dunmer Crusader who can be found in Yasammidan. He carries the Ring of Sanguine Sublime Wisdom.
Angahran is a Dunmer Assassin residing in Balmora. She can be found "patrolling" the Morag Tong Guild.
Angaredhel is a Dunmer Mage residing at the Gateway Inn in Sadrith Mora.

Anis Seloth is a Dunmer alchemist residing in Sadrith Mora. Anis is seen as one of the best alchemist around, and has a recipe for Dispel that she is unwilling to share with anyone. She is a member of House Telvanni.

Anise Romoran is a Dunmer who resides in Morrowind. She is found in Shishi accompanied by two other members of House Redoran, Temis Romavel and Brerama Selas. She is there on a mission to kill the members of a House Telvannioutpost that was recently founded in the area.
Anit Eramarellaku is a Dunmer Barbarian who resides in Shashmanu Camp inside his yurt in the West Gash region. Like the rest of the tribe, he will attack the Nerevarine upon sight.
Ano Andaram is a Dunmer who resides in Vivec City, Morrowind.
Anedhel is a Bosmer and devout worshiper of the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile. She can be found at the Shrine of Clavicus Vile alongside her fellow worshipers.
Angelie is a Redguard living in the Talos Plaza District in the Imperial City.
Anders is a deceased Nord bandit in who is found inside the Twilight Sepulcher, alongside his companion Nystrom.
Ancola is a Redguard residing in Sadrith Mora, Morrowind. She is a member of House Telvanni, and has a number of goods for sale.
Anjari is a Khajiit slave who is residing in the cave of Zainsipilu.

Anhaedra is a Dremora found at Maar Gan, and has been placed there by Vivec. He has to endure pilgrims hitting him, whilst having a Sanctuary blessing protecting them. Asking Alds Baro about rumors at the Maar Gan Outpost will reveal that Anhaedra has been short-tempered lately.

Anes Vendu is a deceased Dunmer and commoner whose body is found in the lower levels of Nchuleftingth in Molag Amur. Edwinna Elbert is interested in the notes that he is carrying in the quest "Nchuleftingth Expedition."
Andolos Darethi is a Dunmer found in the region of Stonefalls, Morrowind.
Andawen is an Altmer who may be found in the region of Auridon in the Summerset Isles. She is involved with the quest "The Mellari-Mora."

Angolin is an Altmer ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed, and once the ghosts have returned to the temple. He cannot be directly interacted with.
Angalanwen is an Altmer residing in the city of Vulkhel Guard in Auridon. She has no unique dialogue.
Angren is a Bosmer commoner residing in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Andorie is an Altmer mystic residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She is a member of the Mages Guild.
Aninwe is an Altmer residing in Phaer, Auridon. Aninwe leased the barn that Hendil would come to use during the events of Plague of Phaer.
Anirmelda is an Altmer armsman residing in Woodhearth and a member of the Fighters Guild. She can be found Woodhearth's local guild hall.
Andenyerinwe is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She is also a member of the Mages Guild.
Aniralda is an Altmer fisher residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. She can be found on the upper floor of the Altmer Embassy.

Aniette is a Breton residing in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She is typically found sitting high up on a rock that overlooks the Daggerfall Marketplace. Beside her is Cimon, lying on the ground.
Andree is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle in Stormhaven. She is located at the Mages Guild, leaning against the stonewall.
Annabelle Lemaitre is a Redguard residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. She is the brewer in the Cloudy Dregs Inn, not far from the north gate in the city.
Andalore is an Altmer alchemist residing in Kragenmoor in the region of Stonefalls. She can be found in the store Ash Shadow Alchemists.
Andame is an Altmer residing in Geirmund's Hall in the region of The Rift.
Andewen is an Altmer residing in Ezduiin in the region of Auridon. She is one of Telenger the Artificer's assistants. She can also be found in Ebon Stadmont in Summerset.
Angelenwen is an Altmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Haven.
Angwe is an Altmer chef residing in the city of Stormhold, Shadowfen.
Andur is an Altmer member of the Veiled Heritance serving as Aranias's bodyguard.
Andal-ma is a Khajiit of the Baandari Clan found in their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Andeleine Vervins is a Breton laborer found listening to a speech by Sir Khnanya at-Salan by the Daggerfall Docks. She has no unique dialogue.
Andilan Ules is a Dunmer who resides at the Shad Astula academy. She can be found by the gateway.
Andrec Dugot is a member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of Wayrest.
Anenya is an Altmer member of the Mages Guild who has been sent to retrieve a powerful relic found deep inside the Erokii Ruins.
Angranel is a Bosmer mercenary merchant residing in the Western Elsweyr Gate in Cyrodiil.
Aneyda Uvaril is a Dunmer found just outside of the Tal'Deic Fortress, in Deshaan.
Angardil is an Altmer residing in the city of Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
Anglorn is a Bosmer found in the Shadows Crawl. He is a worshipper of Ze'n, and he and his clan have been driven from their home by Wood Orcs.
Angrestag is a Nord found eating bread at the Docks of Shad Astula. He has no unique dialogue.
Annarique Pamarc is a moneylender part of the group of outlaws found underneath Stormhold.
Angata the Clannfear Handler is a Dremora found in The Banished Cells. They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Andrei is a Nord working at Hfirorg Farm. He cannot be interacted with.
Annia Sisenna is an Imperial soldier of the Imperial Legion found at the Aldmeri Dominion Base inside the Imperial City Sewers.
Anka-Ra Arcanist is a member of the Anka-Ra residing in the region of Craglorn.
Anka-Ra Archer is a member of the Anka-Ra residing in the region of Craglorn.
Anka-Ra Sentinel is a member of the Anka-Ra residing in the region of Craglorn.
Anka-Ra Shadowcaster is a Redguard member of the Anka-Ra found at the Dragonstar Arena in the region of Craglorn.
Anka-Ra Swordsman is a member of the Anka-Ra residing in the region of Craglorn.
Anka-Ra Thundermaul is a Redguard member of the Anka-Ra residing in the region of Craglorn.
Ancolcalion is an Altmer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Anconath is a deceased Altmer whose spirit resides within Crypt of Hearts I in Rivenspire. He returns in Crypt of Hearts II after reentering the portal once Alanwe has sacrificed herself.
Anirione is an Altmer traveling merchant. She can be found in various locations across The Rift. She can be intimidated to give her pack. It counts towards the achievement Crime Pays.
Annagail is a Bosmer bard residing in Skywatch. She plays for the celebrants there.
Androche Lanie is a Breton residing in Kerbol's Hollow. He can be found near the butchering stand near the forge.
Angirgoth is a powerful Herne encountered in the fifth round of the Maelstrom Arena.
Ancient Blademaster is a skeleton ravager that appears in the Gandranen Ruins in .
Andilo Barus is a Dunmer artisan residing in Vivec City. He may be found sitting down at Foundation's Embrace, or wandering around the other nearby marketplaces.
Andronica is a character in . She only appears if The Forgotten Hero has lowered Garnag's health below 10 points, after which she will replace him and fight until she dies.

Andranon is a Bosmer drunkard residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He calls himself an "aprax," a Mer who has been cast out from Altmeri society.
Anger is a Nord who appears in Pelagius the Mad's mind during the quest "The Mind of Madness."
Anjolda is a Nord found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. She has no unique dialogue.
Angetha is a Breton found within the Undercroft Great Hall of the Monastery of Serene Harmony in Shimmerene. She has no unique dialogue.
Alexis Ervine is a Altmer who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.

Anka-Ra Destroyer is a Yokudan warrior of the Ra Gada, a type of an Anka-Ra found inside the Hel Ra Citadel Trial, encountered for the duration of it. Anka-Ra Destroyers are noticed by their blue banners on their back and their usage of two-handed swords.
Angharal Suth is a Dunmer member of House Telvanni residing in the Council House of Sadrith Mora. She serves as the Mouth of Nelos Otheri.
Aneshi the Shrine Keeper is a Khajiit who appears in the region of Northern Elsweyr.

Animated Troll Statue are a variation of troll in . As their name suggests, they are enchanted animated statues of trolls. They can only be encountered during the Exhibition Fight of the Round 4 of the Arena.
Angeira is a Redguard wandering near Fillies and Foals in Lilmoth. She has no dialogue.
Anglalas is a Bosmer merchant in . He can be found with his horse at the store "The Vagabond's Vendor" between King's Haven Pass Wayshrine and Gryphon Aerie.
Anneke is a Nord located in various locations in Craglorn, in .

Antiochus Septim was the seventh monarch to rule the Empire of Tamriel during the Third Era. Possibly due to being neglected by his parents, Antiochus became known to many Imperials as a drunkard and womanizer by the age of sixteen. He was crowned Emperor of Tamriel, at the age of forty-eight, in 3E 99 after his father, Pelagius Septim II, died. Antiochus was famous throughout his reign for grandiose living, from a strong concern with fashion to his many mistresses. Antiochus ruled Tamriel for thirteen years. Despite his moral laxity, he proved to be an able ruler.

Ano Vando is a Dunmer found in Ald'ruhn. He is employed as a vampire hunter, as was his father and grandfather before him. The Nerevarine will be asked to kill him is a member of the Aundae Clan. He smites the vampires he hunts with a mace called Light of Day, and he defends himself with the Darksun Shield.
Apelles Matius is an Imperial guard and an inspector that arrived in Vvardenfell from Cyrodiil to inspect Ebonheart and Vvardenfell.

Antus Odiil is an Imperial warrior and the youngest son of Valus Odiil. He is also the brother of Rallus Odiil. The three of them used to live on Odiil Farm until they were driven out by a clan of goblins. They tried to acquire the assistance of the Chorrol Guard but were denied help.

Aralor the Penitent was a male Dunmer. He was the Patron Saint of tanners and miners. Aralor was originally a foul criminal, but he repented his sins and traveled a great circuit of the pilgrimages on his knees. His famed hair shirt is an artifact coveted by the Tribunal Temple. During the events of , shrines dedicated to him can be found across Vvardenfell inside Temples, such as the High Fane in Vivec City, the Ghostgate Temple in the Ashlands, or the Holamayan Monastery in the Azura's Coast region.
Antoinetta Marie is a Breton assassin and member of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary of the Dark Brotherhood in .

Antus Pinder was a hero of Kvatch. Despite his facing a greatly superior foe, he stood his ground and fought valiantly in the name of his people. Though his grossly inferior forces were crushed, his bravery in the face of overwhelming odds would later see itself honored through the erection of a statue in Kvatch in his honor.
Anya Herrick is a highly paranoid Breton noble who is Lady Syl's Stewardess. Anya is fearful of the outside, and is grateful to Syl for her job which is safe indoors.
Anoriath is a Bosmer hunter and merchant in Whiterun and the co-owner of the The Drunken Huntsman.
Anwen is a Redguard priestess in who lives in the Temple of Dibella in Markarth.
Aquillius Aeresius is an Imperial citizen living in Solitude.
Arathor is a Bosmer scout residing in Balmora. He is a member of the Thieves Guild and can be found at the South Wall Cornerclub.
Antoine Branck is a Breton who takes care of the horses at Bay Roan Stables in Bravil.
Ansu Senatbael is a Dunmer Mabrigash who resides at a roadside camp in the Grazelands of Morrowind. She is hostile and will attack on sight.

Antu Assarrimisun is a Dunmer Wise Woman who resides in the Ashlands of Vvardenfell. She is hostile and will attack on sight. She shares her campsite with two other hostiles, Selk Muddumummu and Zairan Enturnabaelul.

Aralosea Romori is a Dunmer Battlemage and worshipper of Sheogorath who resides in Almurbalarammi. Aralosea carries a copy of The Art of War Magic, a Destruction skill book. Like the other worshipers in Almurbalarammi, Aralosea is hostile to all outsiders and will attack on sight.
Arara Uvulas is a Dunmer sorceress, and the Mouth for Master Neloth. She is a member of the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora.
Aras Girendas is a Dunmer bandit found in Zenarbael. He will be hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight.

Anvil Jailor is an Imperial guard guarding the Anvil Dungeons. There are two of them, a man and a woman who take shifts between day and night. When one of them is on their shift, the other can be found sleeping in an unlocked jail cell in the dungeon, located directly to the left when the room containing the cells is entered.
Anvil Soldier is an Imperial warrior who participates in Allies for Bruma.

Aradraen is a Bosmer sharpshooter who owns a shop in the lower waistworks of Vivec City's Foreign Quarter. She sells enchanted weapons and arrows. While she is the only character who sells these, she also has an unlimited supply. She is a major trainer in Marksman, and a medium trainer in Medium Armor and Sneak.
Anora is a Redguard Spellsword residing in Tel Aruhn. She is a member of House Telvanni.
Aranwen is a Bosmer barbarian and slaver, and resides in the slaver cave of Zainsipilu. She will be hostile towards the Nerevarine on sight.
Arabhi is a Khajiit slave who resides in the Dren Plantation, Doves' Shack.

Arannir is a Bosmer acrobat who resides in Mababi, a Veloth tower used by members of House Telvanni. Arannir, along with the rest of the inhabitants, will attack any intruder who is not a member of the house.
